pre_change_reproduction.program:
import json
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
from flepimop2.axis import ResolvedShape
from flepimop2.parameter.abc import ModelStateSpecification, ParameterValue
from flepimop2.typing import StateChangeEnum
from benchmarks.prepared_execution import _RateSystem, _configure_structured_options
from flepimop2.engine.op_engine import OpEngineEngineConfig, OpEngineFlepimop2Engine
jax.config.update('jax_enable_x64', True)
rows=[]
for layout in ['flat','pytree','block']:
 for loop in [None,'unroll','scan']:
  kw={'method':'rk4','fixed_max_step':0.125,'state_layout':layout}
  if layout=='block':kw['block_axis']='batch'
  if loop is not None:kw['fixed_loop']=loop
  config=OpEngineEngineConfig(**kw)
  system=_RateSystem();_configure_structured_options(system,4)
  shape=ResolvedShape(('batch',),(4,));rate=jnp.full((4,),-0.1);initial=jnp.ones(4)
  engine=OpEngineFlepimop2Engine(state_change=StateChangeEnum.FLOW,config=config)
  prepared=engine.prepare(system,np.asarray([0.,0.5,1.]),{'x':ParameterValue(initial,shape)},{'rate':ParameterValue(rate,shape)},model_state=ModelStateSpecification(parameter_names=('x',)))
  def solve(r,y):return prepared({'x':y},{'rate':r})[-1,1:]
  graph=jax.make_jaxpr(solve)(rate,initial)
  value,gradient=jax.jit(jax.value_and_grad(lambda r:jnp.sum(solve(r,initial))))(rate)
  rows.append({'layout':layout,'requested_loop':loop,'core_loop':config.to_run_config().fixed_loop,'top_level_scans':sum(e.primitive.name=='scan' for e in graph.jaxpr.eqns),'top_level_equations':len(graph.jaxpr.eqns),'value_error':float(abs(value-4*np.exp(-.1))),'gradient_error':float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(gradient)-np.exp(-.1))))})
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

limitations: Public synthetic CPU exponential fixture; no application/production workload or GPU measured.
Three fresh workers per case, alternating/reversed case order; shared host with singleton CPU affinity and requested thread controls. Effective thread pools were not sampled.
Within each worker ordinary runs before prepared; selected compilation follows tracing and backend setup, not whole-process cold startup.
Trace and warm entries are within-worker medians of three samples; individual inner samples are not retained by this harness. All outer worker records are retained.
Peak RSS includes both execution paths, tracing, compilation and backend startup. It is not per-path live solver memory. XLA temporary bytes are separate compiler estimates.
Omitted provider settings already selected scans before the change. These compare execution choices; they are not a default-path implementation speedup or calibration evidence.
